create_lightglue_config: create a LightGlueConfig with custom descriptor_dim, depth_confidence, and width_confidence settings
build_lightglue_model: build a LightGlueForKeypointMatching model from a LightGlueConfig for keypoint matching between image pairs
run_keypoint_matching: run keypoint matching on two images using LightGlueForKeypointMatching and return matches with scores
test_early_stopping: test early stopping behavior of LightGlueForKeypointMatching based on depth_confidence threshold
review_pruning: review keypoint pruning logic in LightGlueForKeypointMatching based on width_confidence and matchability scores
